text: dsh-desktop-restart 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏添加界面刷新和桌面应用重启按钮。刷新仅重新加载页面与客户端插件，Host 继续运行；重启需再次确认，并由 Host 处理。界面提供中英文状态提示，也会显示活动 Agent 状态。插件通过 bundle patch 注入 Host 服务，适用于 Windows 桌面版 DSH，要求版本 0.2.1-rc.2 或更新版本，不需要额外 API key。

dsh-desktop-restart adds DSH sidebar buttons to reload the interface or restart the desktop app. Reload leaves the Host running; restart requires confirmation and is handled by the Host. It supports Windows desktop DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 or later and needs no API key.
想从 DSH 侧栏快速刷新界面，但不重启 Host。
需要在 Windows 桌面版里点按钮重启整个 DSH 应用。
Can I add sidebar buttons to reload the DSH page or restart its desktop app?
dsh-desktop-restart 的功能「刷新界面」：点击侧栏的刷新按钮会重新加载当前页面与客户端插件，Host 保持运行。按钮显示刷新状态，并在应用重启期间禁用。
dsh-desktop-restart 的功能「重启桌面应用」：点击侧栏按钮后再次确认，客户端向 Host 的重启路由提交请求；Host 先检查桌面状态与安装活动，再安排应用重新启动。按钮显示任务活动提示和执行结果。

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · dsh-desktop-restart：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Two buttons in the sidebar foot of the **DeepSeek Harness desktop app**: reload the interface, or restart the entire application (app + Host).

The production desktop shell ships no *Reload Page* menu item and no built-in accelerator for it, and it exposes no way to relaunch itself — `app.relaunch()` lives in the Electron main process and is wired only to crash recovery. This plugin adds both, as ordinary sidebar actions.

```
[⟲ 刷新界面] [↻ 重启应用]
```

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · dsh-desktop-restart：| Button | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Reload UI** | `location.reload()`. Reloads the page and every client plugin; the Host keeps running and turns in flight are not interrupted. |
| **Restart app** | Asks the Host to end every process of the application binary and start it again from the same path. Second click to confirm; the label turns red when Agent turns are running. |

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · Install：From npm:

```powershell
pnpm add @moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart
```

From a local checkout, while developing:

```powershell

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · "dependencies": { "@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart": "link:D:/path/to/dsh-desktop-restart" }：pnpm install
```

Either way, the package must also be registered as a bundle — **that entry is what actually loads it**:

```json
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ ..., "@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart" ] } }
```

A package that is installed but **absent from `dsh.profile.bundles` silently does nothing**: it produces no error and no button. Add the bundle entry, then restart the app.

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · "dependencies": { "@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart": "link:D:/path/to/dsh-desktop-restart" }：The package ships its own `cordis.patch.yml`, which inserts the Host-side service, so no edit to the profile patch layer is needed.

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · Plugin market index (self-hosted)：`market/index.json` in this repository is a **format 1 plugin market index**, validated by DSH's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index`. To see this plugin in the desktop app's **Plugins → Discover** tab:

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · Plugin market index (self-hosted)：Every version entry carries `engines.dsh` matching `package.json`; the Discover tab derives compatibility and the default version from it, and disables **Install** when no version is compatible. When publishing a new version, append a `versions` entry with `version`, the real publish time as Unix seconds in `publishTimestamp`, and `source.type: "npm"`.

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · How the restart works：So the order is inverted:

```
Client click
  -> POST /desktop-restart/restart
    -> Host writes watchdog.ps1 + launch.vbs, spawns a helper (powershell -EncodedCommand, not detached)
      -> helper creates a one-shot scheduled task: wscript.exe launch.vbs   (GUI subsystem, no console)

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · HTTP routes：| Route | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /desktop-restart/status` | `{ desktop, restarting, activeAgents, logPath }` |
| `POST /desktop-restart/restart` | Needs header `x-dsh-desktop-restart: 1` (or the desktop proxy shape: loopback peer, no `Host`/`Origin` header) |
| `POST /desktop-restart/diagnose` | Arms a watchdog in probe mode and reports `{ armed, method }`. Kills nothing — use it to check the chain without restarting. |

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · Files：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: routes, helper/watchdog generation, arming, kill/relaunch mode |
| `client.js` | Client half: the two sidebar actions, styles, zh/en dictionaries, confirm state machine |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the Host service into the profile |
| `package.json` | Declares both halves (`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`) |
| `locale/*.json` | Plugin page name and description |
| `icon.svg` | Sidebar icon |

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · Files：Because the package declares a Host half, **every code change — including one that only touches `client.js` — needs an app restart** to take effect. "Reload UI" only reloads the page; it does not rebuild the Host-side bundle graph, so reloading after editing `client.js` makes the page fetch a bundle that no longer matches the file on disk, which throws `import failed` and blocks startup. **Verify changes with "Restart app", never with a reload.**

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · Known limitations：- **The restart is a hard kill** (`TerminateProcess`). The turn in flight is interrupted. Session history and anything already written to disk are unaffected.
- **A restart is refused while a package manager is installing into the profile** (`409 installing`). Three signals are checked: the plugin manager's own `plugin-manager/install-state` reports (`installing` / `cancelling` / `applying`) — authoritative, but it never reports completion, so a phase expires after ten minutes; a manifest written within the last 10 seconds, which catches the moment an install *finishes*, since the lockfile is written last; and, as a fallback, a live `node` process whose command line mentions `pnpm`. The 10-second window is kept short on purpose: a finished install should not block a restart for longer than it takes to notice. All three are best-effort and fail open.
- Only the Windows desktop app is supported. On a plain `dsh web` Host the route answers `409 not-desktop` and the button falls back to reloading the page.
- When the Scheduled Task channel is blocked by policy, the helper falls back to launching PowerShell directly, which may fla

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · Development：```powershell
npm test          # smoke: builders, install guard, both sidebar actions, PS 5.1 parse
node --check index.js
node --check client.js
```

The three script builders are exported as pure functions, so they can be generated and handed to the Windows PowerShell parser without arming anything:

```js
import { watchdogSource, watchdogLauncherSource, restartHelperScript } from '@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart'
```

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · Development：Safe way to exercise the whole chain without touching a live app: generate a watchdog with a **non-existent** executable path, run it with `powershell -File`, and watch the log walk `matched pids:` -> `application gone=True` -> `relaunch issued` -> `watchdog end`.

@moonsand/dsh-desktop-restart README · Logs：Everything the helper and the watchdog do is appended to `%TEMP%\dsh-desktop-restart.log`. This is the first place to look when a restart misbehaves. The `GET /status` route reports the exact path.
